overview: At home you read Anne's letter. A woman from Bridge Street is to do the great wash through the winter at fourpence a week, and she has paid it already out of the Michaelmas money. You were told, not asked. You did not write the answer.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the letter and did not answer it.

parties.name: Anne Shakespeare
parties.context: Had written the decision. She was not in the room.
